value_note: Scores are relative ranks within Manhattan, NOT calibrated experience scores.
score_method: Dimension score = mean of its ranked sub-indicators, each a 0–100 percentile among Manhattan segments (ties take the lowest rank; "fewer is better" indicators reversed). N/A when no ranked sub-indicator is measurable. Overall = equal-weight mean of the available dimension scores; coverage = how many of 12 were available.

source_labels.streets: NYC Street Centerline (LION), NYC DCP via ArcGIS
source_labels.trees: NYC Parks Forestry Tree Points (live inventory)

Architecture.label: Landmark proximity
Architecture.method: Gaussian distance decay Σexp(−d²/2σ²), σ 100 m, cutoff 300 m, mean of points every 40 m along the segment

Architecture.label: Individual landmarks within 150 m
Architecture.method: Landmark lot centroids within 150 m of the segment midpoint

Nature.label: Full-structure inventory trees per km
Nature.method: Trees with structure "Full" within 30 m, snapped to the nearest segment, ÷ length (80 m floor). Full is a structural inventory category and can include Dead or Unknown condition; not measured canopy shade

Nature.label: Beside parkland
Nature.method: Share of points 0/±20/±40 m from the centreline inside NYC Parks properties

Nature.label: Living trees along segment
Nature.method: Raw count behind trees per km

Culture.label: Cultural venue proximity
Culture.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 150 m, cutoff 450 m: museums, galleries, theatres, arts centres, cinemas, libraries, music venues

Culture.label: Cultural venues within 200 m
Culture.method: Count within 200 m of the segment midpoint

Quiet & Relax.label: 311 noise complaint intensity
Quiet & Relax.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 50 m, cutoff 150 m, last 12 months; fewer is better. Reporting depends on who calls 311

Quiet & Relax.label: Roadway width
Quiet & Relax.method: LION street width; narrower carries less through-traffic noise. N/A where NYC does not record a width

Quiet & Relax.label: Noise complaints along segment
Quiet & Relax.method: Complaints within 40 m, snapped to the nearest segment

Spatial Comfort.label: Sidewalk surface beside the street
Spatial Comfort.method: Share of points 5/8/11/14 m either side of the centreline inside planimetric sidewalk polygons (a sidewalk-width proxy). N/A on park paths and step streets

Urban Vibrancy.label: Activity mix index
Urban Vibrancy.method: Normalised Shannon diversity of place categories × ln(1 + places), within 150 m

Urban Vibrancy.label: Places within 150 m
Urban Vibrancy.method: OSM amenity, shop, tourism, leisure and historic features

Urban Vibrancy.label: Category diversity
Urban Vibrancy.method: Normalised Shannon entropy of those places

Food & Retail.label: Food & shop proximity
Food & Retail.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 50 m, cutoff 150 m: restaurants, cafés, bars, fast food and all shops

Food & Retail.label: Food & shops per km
Food & Retail.method: Places within 60 m snapped to the nearest segment ÷ length (80 m floor)

Food & Retail.label: Food & shops along segment
Food & Retail.method: Raw count behind places per km

Scenic & Visual.label: Scenic feature proximity
Scenic & Visual.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 100 m, cutoff 300 m: viewpoints, public artworks, fountains, memorials, monuments

Scenic & Visual.label: Scenic features within 150 m
Scenic & Visual.method: Count within 150 m of the segment midpoint

Walkability.label: Intersections within 250 m
Walkability.method: Centreline nodes joining 3+ walkable segments (streets, paths, step streets, alleys) within 250 m of the midpoint

Access & Safety.label: Pedestrian injury crash intensity
Access & Safety.method: Gaussian distance decay, σ 40 m, cutoff 120 m, crashes injuring or killing pedestrians, last 3 years; fewer is better. Not adjusted for pedestrian volume

Access & Safety.label: Pedestrian injury crashes within 25 m
Access & Safety.method: Count within 25 m of the segment, last 3 years

Environment.label: Distance to expressway or ramp
Environment.method: Midpoint to nearest expressway/ramp centreline, capped at 1,500 m; farther means less traffic-pollution exposure

Transit Connectivity.label: Subway entrances within 400 m
Transit Connectivity.method: Entrances with entry allowed within 400 m of the midpoint

Transit Connectivity.label: Distance to nearest subway entrance
Transit Connectivity.method: Midpoint to nearest entrance, capped at 1,500 m
